<description>
The options for wallet funding RPCs have several issues:

* snake_case aliases are accepted by the server, but unsupported by bitcoin-cli, not mentioned in the docs and rejected by the schema.
* If both the snake_case and camelCase are provided, the camelCase is silently ignored.
* The server silently ignores `subtract_fee_from_outputs`. (reported by stutxo in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35317)

Fix all issues, by:

* Adding the snake_case aliases to the CLI, docs and the schema.
* Rejecting if both are supplied.
* Reading `subtract_fee_from_outputs` instead of silently ignoring it.
</description>
